SKETCH v1 posted on STORY-1706 (aida show STORY-1706 --comments).
Design: aida-relay writes a 0600 relay.launch (verbatim args, principal, TTY root, profile sha), trap exit reasons and a --no-restart marker (PR A). The drive tick restarts only a trap-never-ran crash, under 10 fail-closed conditions with a re-check before exec, a scrubbed env and a ledger row (PR B).
3 questions: same-uid trust anchor, the new relay-restart scope needs a re-mint, cross-repo trailers / marker-only stop verb. No code until your signoff.
